notes: CMSA's People page lists ~60 names, the large majority of whom are Faculty Associates whose primary appointment (and, where relevant, their own PI-led lab) is in another Harvard department -- Math, Physics, SEAS, Statistics, Economics, OEB, MCB -- already covered or to be covered by those departments' own targets (e.g. Jeffrey Lichtman -> harvard-mcb, already scraped). CMSA itself does not organize into PI-led labs with members/rosters; its own dedicated researchers (postdocs/research associates such as Douglas, Doran, Dogra, Esfahani, Landesman, Landsittel, Liu, Mori, Nevo, Pesce, Ritzwoller, Verstyuk) are individual mathematicians/physicists without a lab structure. Recording all ~60 names here would duplicate home-department entries with no new information (the page gives name + email + home affiliation only, no research blurb). Left mostly unpopulated; see this note rather than non_lab_people for the full roster. Status: done (page fully read; schema doesn't fit this center).
